lede: The Telluride Hospital District board meets Thursday with a genuinely weighty decision on the table: possible action on a Two Site Model for the new medical facility, plus movement on architect selection and a Letter of Intent — choices that will shape what kind of healthcare infrastructure this valley has for decades. Alongside that, Mountain Village's homeowner association takes up a workforce housing committee and a vote on updated policies, and the Town's brand-new Resident Advisory Committee holds its first-ever meeting to elect leadership and define its role for employee-housing tenants. The Telluride Mountain Run is Saturday, and the Burlesque Buffet wraps its run at the Sheridan this weekend too.

notable.stake: Board may vote on Two Site Model and architect selection for new hospital facility.
TMVOA votes on updated policies, workforce housing committee, and ice pad grant.
Inaugural tenant advisory body elects leadership and sets scope for housing-policy voice.
